title: fs-transferability: code and aggregated results for a leave-one-city-out evaluation of fecal sludge prediction in Sub-Saharan Africa
description: Scripts that download seven open fecal sludge datasets, harmonise them, run leave-one-city-out, within-city and external evaluations of machine-learning models for total solids, volatile solids, COD and ammonium, and reproduce the figures and tables of the accompanying manuscript. Aggregated results are included; sample-level data are rebuilt from the original sources.
